return_value.description: The expected return value of the test case.

used.description: Number of pads the question was used in.

next_cursor.description: The page or cursor to pass to the next request.

description: Create interview pads and questions, and look up Screen campaigns, questions and test results.

coderpad_interview_ended_trigger.description: Runs each time an interview pad is ended in CoderPad. Ones ended before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

coderpad_new_pad_trigger.description: Runs for each new interview pad in CoderPad. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

coderpad_new_question_trigger.description: Runs for each new Interview question in CoderPad. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

coderpad_new_screen_session_trigger.description: Runs for each new Screen test session in CoderPad. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

coderpad_screen_session_completed_trigge.description: Runs each time a screen test session is completed in CoderPad. Ones completed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

coderpad_take_home_submitted_trigger.description: Runs each time a take-home pad is submitted in CoderPad. Ones submitted before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
